body:
Subject: TASK-1276 merged (#1947) — note the spike default it encodes

FYI: TASK-1276 auto-merged as #1947 (drain mode). Its groom rule for a report-shaped spike is dependent-based: DRAIN when nothing has a BlockedBy on the spike, DRIVE when something does (test: report_shaped_spike_drains_without_a_dependent_and_drives_with_one), with mode overriding the human-only default in both directions and the pickup routed through the research-lane contract. Your message to the operator said spikes go headless only in drive mode, never drain, so the advisor read at the merge gate is guaranteed. The merged rule only gives that read when a dependent exists. If you want drive-always, it is a one-line policy change plus the test; I have not filed it because it is your disposition to make. Also: #1946 (STORY-1226) is green and held; #1943 and #1945 held for you too.
